chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Ibn Ri'ab from Zurarah from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): In

a man who died and left a daughter and a sister (from father and mother). He said: 'The wealth belongs to the daughter, and the sister (from father and mother) gets nothing from the father and mother.'

key_terms.لِأَبِيهِ وَأُمِّهِ: from his father and mother (full sibling)

ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of a full sister when a daughter is present?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the principle of 'blocking' (hajb) in Shia inheritance jurisprudence, where the presence of a daughter excludes the full sister from receiving any share. It highlights the distinct Shia interpretation that a single daughter takes the entire estate in the absence of male heirs, contrasting with other schools that might assign her a half-share and leave the remainder for the sister.
